profile_text.body:
Netflix describes itself as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games, and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. The company states that members can play, pause, and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. It reports over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.

The company's own site text does not mention specific AI products, and the available material does not describe an AI product line or AI positioning.

Netflix is a for-profit public company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, trading under the ticker NFLX, with SEC CIK 0001065280. The company has 281 litigation matters in California.
